title: Qlik Reload Task Failures
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), reload task history, section access audit, Qlik Cloud events (`com.qlik.v1.*`) and app/reload metrics via REST.
app: Qlik Sense Enterprise logs (Scheduler/Engine/Proxy/Repository) via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Cloud events via the Qlik Cloud REST API through HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:scheduler task_type=reload
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(result="Failed")) as failures by task_name, app_name
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/runs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks Qlik Sense reload tasks and ranks apps whose data reloads are failing, exposing the sheets serving stale data.
value: A failed Qlik reload means an app shows outdated figures; ranking by failure rate targets the most unreliable apps.
implementation: Ingest `qlik:scheduler` logs (or poll the QRS/Cloud API); schedule hourly; alert on failures for business-critical apps.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of reload failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the data reloads behind your Qlik apps and tell you when one fails so an app does not show old numbers.
